Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the mountains, the river or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Season: winter — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Small moment: a light smudge of flour marks her cheek.
Outfit: a plunging satin teddy with lace insets at the waist and narrow straps — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a few thin stacked bangles on one wrist, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.

COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the right of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a long dyer's brush of pale bamboo — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
